why.en: Nine dengue deaths in one day signals a health crisis hitting Bangladesh hard right now.

en.title: Kenya's first Ebola death confirmed
en.text: Kenya has confirmed its first Ebola death with 28 contacts identified. This is a major health alert for the region.
